Fold it into a simple envelope shape. - **Pro tip**: Write "恭喜" (Congratulations) or "新年快乐" on it to make it festive. - **Money tips**: - Use ** clean, uncrumpled bills** ( even if not "new"— it’s the gesture that counts!). - Avoid amounts with "4" (e.g., ¥40, ¥400).
